prompts.concept: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a NEW, much SIMPLER design concept for the same WordNCode Pixel Studio team office app. This must look like genuine hand-placed LOW RESOLUTION 2D PIXEL ART from a charming tiny 16-bit management game. The entire illustration is conceived at native 384x256 pixels and enlarged EXACTLY 4x with nearest-neighbor: ALL corners and contours are square stepped pixel clusters, NO smooth curves, no watercolor, no painterly rendering, no rich illustrations, no voxel 3D. Very limited 16-24 colour palette: ink navy outline, warm ivory, sand, oak brown, muted teal, sage, terracotta and soft lavender. Flat colour areas with ONE simple shadow shade, NO textures, NO gradients, NO wood grain, NO microdetails. Wide 1536x1024 finished art direction board: top ~75% a very simple app mockup with narrow dark navy left rail, cream header with only the text 'PIXEL STUDIO', central orthographic isometric 2:1 office as a small cute flat pixel tilemap, a narrow right strip of THREE square pixel portraits labeled Claude, GPT, Gemini. Bottom ~25% a lineup of NINE separate unique tiny chibi office characters, all designed as 24x32 pixel sprites and enlarged 4x, plus 8 simple palette squares. No small illegible writing. Office has 7 clearly readable simple spaces with low walls: open studio on left, meeting upper right, leader room middle right, reception bottom middle, coffee bottom left, lounge bottom right, garden at back. Keep furniture few and iconic: simple desks with one silver computer each, chairs, one meeting table, sofa, coffee counter, 4 simple potted plants and a few windows. Broad plain oak-coloured floor with a few plank lines, NOT checkerboard. Do not fill it with books, props or clutter. Characters are friendly 2.5-head-tall adults: Claude chestnut wavy bob, ivory blouse/terracotta trousers; GPT black hair/round glasses/navy jacket; Gemini black high bun/lavender cardigan/plum trousers; coral-jacket design lead woman; grey-haired walnut-blazer director man; olive-vest glasses finance lead woman; mustard-hoodie male intern; blue-cap female courier; terracotta-coat female visitor. Very simple faces: two one-pixel eyes and one-pixel mouth. These must be REAL chunky PIXEL SPRITES, not detailed anime portraits. Prioritize large readable silhouettes, breathing room, simple flat shapes and intentional pixel clusters. Fewer objects and fewer details throughout. No logos except existing project text, no photorealism, no blur, no lighting bloom. Show an attractive clean SIMPLE game UI and environment.
prompts.claude: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION GAME CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS on genuine transparent alpha. Use the attached approved concept only as the STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE, specifically its chunky simple nine-person lineup at the bottom. Make ONE character only, same original simple 2D pixel-art style. Square 1024x1024 canvas containing EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 equal 256x256 cells. Every sprite is centered in its own cell with generous TRANSPARENT gutters, no overlap across cells, no cell outlines, NO text, NO labels, NO background, NO floor, NO shadows, no chair, no desk. Draw a chunky low-resolution game sprite conceived around 32x48 logical pixels, enlarged by a single consistent nearest-neighbor grid. Two-and-a-half-head-tall adult proportions, two pixel eyes, very few colours, hard stepped edges, flat colours with one shadow shade. NOT smooth illustration, NOT detailed anime, NOT voxel. Same identity/outfit/scale in ALL cells. Cell order is strict: row1 left-to-right STANDING FRONT full body, STANDING RIGHT PROFILE full body, STANDING BACK full body, FRONT FACE PORTRAIT head-and-shoulders closeup. Row2 WALKING FRONT step1, WALKING FRONT step2, WALKING BACK step1, WALKING BACK step2. Row3 WALKING RIGHT PROFILE step1, WALKING RIGHT PROFILE step2, SITTING FRONT arms forward to type at an external keyboard (no furniture/no laptop), SITTING RIGHT PROFILE knees bent and arms forward to type (no furniture/no laptop). Row4 SITTING BACK arms forward (no furniture), STANDING FRONT holding a small coffee cup, STANDING RIGHT PROFILE drinking a small coffee cup, STANDING FRONT presenting with one arm raised to gesture. All FULL BODY except the one portrait. Feet consistent baseline within their cells, seated figures naturally shorter. Transparent pixels must surround each cutout. Avoid antialiasing and subtle gradients; use readable large pixel clusters. Keep designs very simple like the approved image. Character: Claude / team leader. Appearance: adult woman with chestnut wavy bob hair, ivory collared blouse, terracotta trousers, cream sneakers, calm friendly face. Produce the entire 16-cell atlas for this one person only.
